Job Description:

Position Overview

The primary responsibility of the Associate Software Engineer is to assist in developing and enhancing our Casino Management System, ensuring high-quality software that meets user and market demands. The Software Engineer is passionate about building innovative applications using modern technologies.

All duties are to be performed in accordance with departmental and Las Vegas Sands Corp.’s policies, practices, and procedures. All Las Vegas Sands Corp. Team Members are expected to conduct and carry themselves in a professional manner at all times. Team Members are required to observe the Company’s standards, work requirements and rules of conduct.   

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Assist in designing, developing, and implementing scalable features using Node.js, React, and JavaScript/TypeScript. 

Write clean, efficient, and well-documented code. 

Collaborate with cross-functional teams (design, product, QA) to understand requirements and contribute to effective solutions. 

Participate in project planning and contribute to timely software delivery. 

Engage in code reviews and contribute to maintaining high coding standards. 

Collaborate with team members to identify and resolve technical issues. 

Stay up to date with the latest technologies and best practices in software development. 

Seek opportunities to improve your skills and knowledge. 

Participate in Agile development processes, including sprint planning and retrospectives. 

Perform job duties in a safe manner.

Attend work as scheduled on a consistent and regular basis.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Minimum Qualifications

At least 21 years of age.

Proof of authorization to work in the United States.

Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience. 

Must be able to obtain and maintain any certification or license, as required by law or policy. 

1+ years of experience in software development, particularly with web technologies. 

Familiarity with programming languages and frameworks such as JavaScript, Node.js, React, HTML/CSS. 

Familiarity with Kubernetes.

Basic understanding of RESTful APIs, JSON, and database technologies (SQL and NoSQL). 

Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) is a plus. 

Good written and verbal communication skills. 

Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. 

Physical Requirements

Must be able to:

Physically access assigned workspace areas with or without reasonable accommodation.

Work indoors and be exposed to various environmental factors such as, but not limited to, CRT, noise, and dust.

Utilize laptop and standard keyboard to perform essential functions of the job.
